    n = mol.GetNumAtoms()
    xyz = np.zeros((n,3))

        p = conf.GetAtomPosition(i)
        xyz[i] = [p.x, p.y, p.z]

def set_coords(mol, xyz):
    conf = mol.GetConformer()
    for i in range(mol.GetNumAtoms()):
        conf.SetAtomPosition(i, xyz[i])

def norm(v):
    return v/np.linalg.norm(v)

def rot_from_bases(a,b, A,B):
    # a,b orthonormal-ish in source; A,B orthonormal in target. Build R mapping a->A, b->B, (axb)->(AxB)
    a = norm(a); b = b - np.dot(b,a)*a; b = norm(b); c = np.cross(a,b)
    A = norm(A); B = B - np.dot(B,A)*A; B = norm(B); C = np.cross(A,B)

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, rdDistGeom
import numpy as np

def embed_opt(smiles, seed):
    mol = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smiles)
    mol = Chem.AddHs(mol)
    ps = rdDistGeom.ETKDGv3()
    ps.randomSeed = seed
    ps.useRandomCoords = True
    ps.maxIterations = 2000
    ok = AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mol, ps)
    if ok != 0:
        ps.useRandomCoords = False
        AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mol, ps)
    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mol, maxIters=3000)
    return mol

def coords(mol):
    conf = mol.GetConformer()
    return np.array([[conf.GetAtomPosition(i).x, conf.GetAtomPosition(i).y, conf.GetAtomPosition(i).z] for i in range(mol.GetNumAtoms())])

def norm(v): 
    n = np.linalg.norm(v); return v/n if n>1e-12 else v

def basis_map(p_src, p_tgt):
    # p_src, p_tgt: (3,3) rows are three corresponding points; returns R,t mapping src->tgt (proper rotation via Kabsch on the triangle)
    cs = p_src.mean(0); ct = p_tgt.mean(0)
    X = p_src - cs; Y = p_tgt - ct
    H = X.T @ Y
    U,S,Vt = np.linalg.svd(H)
    d = np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T @ U.T))
    D = np.diag([1,1,d])
    R = Vt.T @ D @ U.T
    t = ct - R @ cs
    return R,t

def apply(RT, xyz):
    R,t = RT
    return (R @ xyz.T).T + t

# ================= XANTPHOS =================
xant = embed_opt("CC1(C)c2c(P(c3ccccc3)c3ccccc3)cccc2Oc2cccc(P(c3ccccc3)c3ccccc3)c21", seed=7)
X = coords(xant)
Ps = [a.GetIdx() for a in xant.GetAtoms() if a.GetSymbol()=='P']
assert len(Ps)==2, Ps
P1,P2 = Ps
rP = 2.30
def lone_pair(mol, xyz, pidx):
    p = xyz[pidx]
    s = np.zeros(3)
    for n in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(pidx).GetNeighbors():
        s += norm(xyz[n.GetIdx()] - p)
    return -norm(s)
lp1 = lone_pair(xant, X, P1); lp2 = lone_pair(xant, X, P2)
M1 = X[P1] + rP*lp1; M2 = X[P2] + rP*lp2
Mx = 0.5*(M1+M2)
print("xant P1P2 dist", np.linalg.norm(X[P1]-X[P2]), " M1M2 dist", np.linalg.norm(M1-M2))
print("|MxP1|", np.linalg.norm(Mx-X[P1]), "|MxP2|", np.linalg.norm(Mx-X[P2]))

# Build frame: a = from Mx toward midpoint(P1,P2) -> +X ; b = along (P1-P2) perp to a -> +Y ; c->+Z
midx = 0.5*(X[P1]+X[P2])
a = norm(midx - Mx)
b_raw = X[P1]-X[P2]
b = norm(b_raw - np.dot(b_raw,a)*a)
# choose sign of b so that P1 goes +Y
if np.dot((X[P1]-midx), b) < 0: b = -b
R = basis_map_pts = None
# Construct rotation mapping (a,b,c)->(X,Y,Z)
c = np.cross(a,b)
Msrc = np.column_stack([a,b,c])
Mtgt = np.eye(3)
Rx = Mtgt @ Msrc.T   # maps a->ex, b->ey, c->ez
tx = -Rx @ Mx        # translate Mx to origin
Xa = (Rx @ X.T).T + tx
# now P1 should be +y, P2 -y, both x>0
print("after xant transform: P1", Xa[P1], " P2", Xa[P2], " O?", )

# ================= PPY (cyclometalated) =================
ppy = embed_opt("c1ccc(-c2ccccn2)cc1", seed=11)
Y = coords(ppy)
# rings
ri = ppy.GetRingInfo()
rings = [list(r) for r in ri.AtomRings() if len(r)==6]
Nidx = [a.GetIdx() for a in ppy.GetAtoms() if a.GetSymbol()=='N'][0]
ring_N = [r for r in rings if Nidx in r][0]
ring_Ph = [r for r in rings if Nidx not in r][0]
setN, setPh = set(ring_N), set(ring_Ph)
# biaryl bond: atom in ring_N bonded to atom in ring_Ph
ipso_pyr = ipso_ph = None
for b in ppy.GetBonds():
    i,j = b.GetBeginAtomIdx(), b.GetEndAtomIdx()
    if (i in setN and j in setPh):
        ipso_pyr, ipso_ph = i,j
    elif (j in setN and i in setPh):
        ipso_pyr, ipso_ph = j,i
assert ipso_pyr is not None
# phenyl ortho candidates = neighbors of ipso_ph within ring_Ph
ortho = [n.GetIdx() for n in ppy.GetAtomWithIdx(ipso_ph).GetNeighbors() if n.GetIdx() in setPh]
assert len(ortho)==2, ortho
# choose syn to N via |dihedral N - ipso_pyr - ipso_ph - ortho| minimal
from rdkit.Chem import rdMolTransforms as T
conf = ppy.GetConformer()
def dih(a,b,c,d):
    return T.GetDihedralDeg(conf,a,b,c,d)
cands = [(abs(dih(Nidx, ipso_pyr, ipso_ph, o)), o) for o in ortho]
cands.sort()
# we want dihedral ~ 0 (syn). pick smallest abs
Cdon = cands[0][1]
print("ortho dihedrals:", cands, " chosen Cdon", Cdon)
# rotate phenyl about biaryl bond so that dihedral N-ipy-iph-Cdon = 0 (syn, coplanar)
cur = dih(Nidx, ipso_pyr, ipso_ph, Cdon)
T.SetDihedralDeg(conf, Nidx, ipso_pyr, ipso_ph, Cdon, 0.0)
Y = coords(ppy)
print("dihedral after set", dih(Nidx, ipso_pyr, ipso_ph, Cdon))

# metal point for ppy: in plane, opposite side of N-Cdon line from bridging atoms (ipso_pyr, ipso_ph)
rN, rC = 2.10, 2.02
Nv, Cv = Y[Nidx], Y[Cdon]
mid = 0.5*(Nv+Cv)
w = 0.5*(Y[ipso_pyr]+Y[ipso_ph]) - mid   # toward ligand interior
e_axis = norm(Cv - Nv)
d = np.linalg.norm(Cv-Nv)
a_len = (rN*rN - rC*rC + d*d)/(2*d)
h = np.sqrt(max(rN*rN - a_len*a_len, 1e-6))
# in-plane perp pointing away from interior
w_perp = w - np.dot(w, e_axis)*e_axis
e_perp = -norm(w_perp)   # opposite to interior
Mp = Nv + a_len*e_axis + h*e_perp
print("ppy |MpN|", np.linalg.norm(Mp-Nv), "|MpC|", np.linalg.norm(Mp-Cv), " d(N,C)", d)

# frame for ppy: a = from Mp toward midpoint(N,C) -> -X (donors on left); b along (N - C) perp -> +Y so N is +y
midNC = 0.5*(Nv+Cv)
ap = norm(midNC - Mp)
bp_raw = Nv - Cv
bp = norm(bp_raw - np.dot(bp_raw,ap)*ap)
if np.dot((Nv-midNC), bp) < 0: bp = -bp
cp = np.cross(ap,bp)
Msrcp = np.column_stack([ap,bp,cp])
# target: ap -> -ex, bp -> +ey, cp -> +ez
At = np.array([-1.0,0,0]); Bt = np.array([0.0,1.0,0]); Ct = np.array([0.0,0,1.0])
Mttp = np.column_stack([At,Bt,Ct])
Rp = Mttp @ Msrcp.T
tp = -Rp @ Mp
Ya = (Rp @ Y.T).T + tp
print("after ppy transform: N", Ya[Nidx], " Cdon", Ya[Cdon])

# sanity: distances from origin
print("Pd-N", np.linalg.norm(Ya[Nidx]), " Pd-C", np.linalg.norm(Ya[Cdon]))
print("Pd-P1", np.linalg.norm(Xa[P1]), " Pd-P2", np.linalg.norm(Xa[P2]))

# H to drop: H on Cdon
Hdrop = [n.GetIdx() for n in ppy.GetAtomWithIdx(Cdon).GetNeighbors() if n.GetSymbol()=='H']
print("Hdrop on Cdon:", Hdrop)

# symbols
sym_x = [a.GetSymbol() for a in xant.GetAtoms()]
sym_y = [a.GetSymbol() for a in ppy.GetAtoms()]
keep_y = [i for i in range(len(sym_y)) if i not in Hdrop]

# combine
symbols = ['Pd'] + sym_x + [sym_y[i] for i in keep_y]
coords_all = [np.array([0.0,0.0,0.0])] + [Xa[i] for i in range(len(sym_x))] + [Ya[i] for i in keep_y]
# donor indices in combined numbering: 0=Pd; xantphos atoms offset 1; ppy offset 1+len(sym_x)
off_x = 1
off_y = 1 + len(sym_x)
# map ppy original idx -> combined idx
map_y = {orig: off_y + k for k,orig in enumerate(keep_y)}
donors = {
    'P1': off_x + P1,
    'P2': off_x + P2,
    'N' : map_y[Nidx],
    'C' : map_y[Cdon],
}
print("donor combined indices:", donors, " total atoms", len(symbols))

with open("assembled.xyz","w") as f:
    f.write(f"{len(symbols)}\nPd(ppy)(xantphos) assembled\n")
    for s,xyz in zip(symbols, coords_all):
        f.write(f"{s:2s} {xyz[0]:12.6f} {xyz[1]:12.6f} {xyz[2]:12.6f}\n")

# quick clash check: min inter-ligand heavy distance
import itertools
nx = len(sym_x)
# xant coords block indices 1..nx ; ppy block off_y..end
minD = 1e9; pair=None
for i in range(1, 1+nx):
    for jj in range(off_y, len(symbols)):
        dd = np.linalg.norm(coords_all[i]-coords_all[jj])
        if dd < minD:
            minD = dd; pair=(i,jj)
print("min inter-ligand distance", minD, "pair", pair, symbols[pair[0]], symbols[pair[1]])
EOF
